(349)༄༅/ /'gro ba'i mgon po dpal phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal pos mdzad pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa bzhugs so/ // /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (349)༄༅// 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal pos mdzad pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa bzhugs so/// /

(350)༄༅// na mo gu ru/ gdams pa'i lo rgyus/ bla ma lha rje mi la la// gdams pa zab mo'i chu mig de// rje rin po che yis gsol gyur pas// srid zhi'i gdung sel bdud rtsi mchog /tha snyad tshig gis ma bslad pa// snyan nas brgyud pa'i man ngag lags/ ༈ gdams pa'i che ba/ bskal pa grangs med 'das pa nas// sangs rgyas dpag med bzhugs pa rnams// lam thab 'di la brten nas kyang*// rang don gzhan don phun tshogs 'grub/ ༈ gdams pa'i snod/ sha za'i gdon/ lha'i bu'i bdud gyis ma bzung zhing*// le lo sdig pa'i sems spangs nas// gnyis su med pa'i bla ma la// dang ba'i yid kyis mi 'bral bar// lus ngag yid kyis mchod gyur te/ ༈ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro/ /g.yeng ba thams cad rab spangs nas// 'du 'dzi med pa'i dgon pa ru// zas gos kyi zhen pa bcad gyur nas// zhen med kyi stan la skyil krung bca'// re dogs med pa'i lag pa bsnol// g.yo sgyu med pa'i sgal tshig bsrangs// rdzun smra med pa'i mgrin pa'i tong tong steng sgo gnon/ ༈ shes rab kyi gol sa bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum dang mi (351)'bral bar// khas blangs dam tshig gzhung bzhin bsrung*// tshe gcig lus gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub// dkar po'i sangs rgyas 'dod lags na// go cha stong dang snying rje gnyis la brten nas su// rnam rtog lam du byed pa yis// mtshan nyid theg pas ma bslad par// skye med rtogs pa'i gdams ngag 'di// bsags pa rab tu gyur pas bsgom// 'jig rten pa yi yang dag lta// chen po su la yod spyad de// sangs rgyas re ba ma mchis kyang*// dkar po'i phyogs kyi chos spyod ni// rgyun chad med par nyams su blang*// ngan 'gro'i dogs pa med na yang*// nyes byas phra zhing phra ba la// mig gi 'bras bur rdul bzhin bsrung*// stong pa'i go cha ci bzang yang*// thabs kyis lam khyer dang du blang*/ ༈

dngos gzhi thod brgal ba'i lam dang po/ /bsam gtan yongs su dag pa yis// yan lag lnga pa bcas gyur nas// snang ba sems su shes bya ste// skye med ngang la bzhag par bya/ ༈ thod brgal ba gnyis pa'i bsgom rim/ /dang po pa yi gang zag ni// nyon mongs rnam rtog byung gyur na// 'dod chags 'di yang rnam rtog ste// rnam rtog de (352)nyid sems su 'dus// sems kyang skye ba med par gnas// bsams la ngang la bzhag par bya// de bzhin rnam rtog ma lus pa// rnam dag 'gres su go bar bya// gsar bu gnas lugs sgom pa ni// rgya mtsho chen po'i rba rlabs bzhin// bsrab shing dwangs par gyur pa las// sangs rgyas lam du shes par bya/ ༈ khams 'dus kyi gegs sel/ 'byung dang gnas dang sad pa yi// las kyi nad rnams byung gyur kyang*// rnam par rtog pa rig pa ste// rig pa rnam thar sgo gsum du// skyes bu dam par shes byas la// dga' ba chen po'i 'du shes kyis// dgos dang sku drin che bar bsam// rnam par rtog pa'i sems nyid la// spong bar 'dod na mang du 'gro// sā lu'i rtsa ba ci 'dra bar// skye ba med pas spang mi dgos// da dung nad kyi sdug bsngal gyis// lus sems 'tshe bar byed pa na// nad dang sdug bsngal ma yin la// gsol ba 'debs pa'i bla mar bsgom// lus kyi khongs su gzer ba dang*// tsha zhing drag la 'khrugs pa rnams// sems gtad sa ru zug pa ni// sa tshang drwa tshags ji lta bar// bsams la nad pa'i tshogs rnams dag /spos kyi dud pa ji lta bar// zug pa'i phyogs nas 'don bya ste// theng lnga drug gis zug las grol// lus po mi na rnam rtog na// snang ba bde chen 'char dus su/ khab kyis btsugs kyang bde ba skye// byams dang snying rje 'byongs pa'i tshe// rang srog gcod pa'i dgra la yang*// ma yi 'du shes yang yang 'byung*// mu stegs nag po sor drug gis// mkha' la dngos po bsgoms gyur te// rnam rtog mkhregs par mthong ba na// lag pa g.yug pas sgra yang thos// zhe sdang skyes pa'i dus tshod du// bskyangs pa'i ma yang dgra ru go

༈ / bsgoms pa'i drod tshad / snying nas sems dul gyur pa na// rmi lam mi ni shi ba bzhin// go bar gyur na rtogs pa skye// gdams ngag rgyal po skyes sbyor 'di// go bar gyur na 'khor 'das gnyis// lag pa'i lto rgyab ji lta bar// nges (353)pa skyes nas thar pa thob// gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 'di// rnam rtog zad na rgyud la 'char// thos bsam sgom gsum shes rab kyis// rang sems bltas na bsam byung yin// rig pa ngang la bzhag tsa na// shugs 'byung sgro 'dogs chod de 'chi// lta rtogs gcig tu gyur pa yin// rnam rtog rang bzhin go tsa na// mkha' la 'phur ba'i bya rjes de// rgan po rnams kyis mi chod ltar// tha snyad zhe bzhag zhig nas 'gro// 'dzin pa 'dug na rnam rtog yin// ngos bzung med pa zung 'jug ste// yod med mtha' las 'das pa yi// rtogs pa gsha' mar skyes gyur na// 'bras bu sku gsum zhes bya ba// skyes bu gsum gyi las rim la// sbyong ba'i 'bad rtsol mi dgos pa// byis pa sman ni 'thungs ba ltar// ngo bo nyid ni shugs las 'byung*/ ༈ de rnams kyi don bsdu ba/ bsod nams tshogs la 'bad pa na// nam mkha' yongs su dag pa la// kha dog tha dad sprin rnams 'byung*// 'od gsal dwangs pa'i rgya mtsho la// rba rlabs gnyer ma skabs su 'byung*// gnyer ma rgya mtshor ma shes na// gzugs brnyan mi mthong gru yang 'jig /rtogs pa skye med shes lags na// spang blang bral ba'i sangs rgyas thob// 'ub kyis hril gyis bsdus pa yin/ ༈ rim gyis sa'i lam zhi gnas rtse gcig / shin tu dben pa'i gnas nyid du// rlung lnga dbang du byed pa la// lus kyi 'khrul 'khor bcas gyur te// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// sdug bsngal mtsho las thar don du// lhan cig skyes sbyor bsgom par bya// rus dang rigs dang phyogs 'dzin gsum// tha mal rnam rtog sna tshogs pas// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung byed pas// yi dam lha yi rnal 'byor bsgom// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rgyu// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus (354)yin// spyi bo'i gtsug tu bsgom par bya// sangs rgyas 'du shes lan gsum bsam// mchod pa gsum gyis mchod byas nas// srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas// mnar med dmyal ba yan chad kyi// phyi nang snod bcud ma lus pa// skye ba med pa'i rnam par bsgom/

༈ lhag mthong spros bral/ lus sems rtog pa byung gyur na// gong gi gdams ngag thog babs bya// dgos dang sku drin che bar blta// che ba'i che lugs 'di lta ste// dkon mchog gsum po rtog pa yin// skabs brgyad lam lnga rnam rtog ste// dbang po lnga yang rnam rtog yin// mchog dang thun mong rnam rtog rgyu// 'jam dpal rol ba'i mdo las gsungs/ ༈ rtog pa lam khyer rgyas bshad/ sems skye ba med pa chos kyi sku// 'gags pa med par longs skur gnas// ngos bzung med pa sprul pa'i sku// de gsum tha dad med pa la// ngo bo nyid skur dam pas gsungs// skye med rtogs pa'i rtogs chos la// dran pa'i rgyal po sgrub pa'i chos// yi ge'i tshogs rnams lung gi chos// dran pas nyes la mi 'jug pa// dge 'dun gsum ka'i ngo bo yin// skye med rtogs pa shes rab la// ngang la gnas pa'i bsam gtan te// rgyun chad med pa brtson 'grus yin// bdag med par go 'jigs med pa// bzod pa gsum gyi rtogs pa ste// spong sems mthar thug gnas gyur pa// rlung sems rtsa ba dag pa ste// tshul khrims pha rol phyin par gsungs// pha rol phyin lnga'i rang bzhin 'di// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i don du spyad// zhen 'dzin rnam rtog bral gyur na// dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi dag dang*// dad dang dran dang brtson 'grus dang*// shes rab dbang po lnga la sogs// rnam par rtog pa'i bye brag tu// sa bcu mchog la gnas pa yi// mgon po byams pas bka' stsal to// de bas (355)rnam rtog med gyur na// dkar po'i bsam pa mi 'grub pas// mkha' la me tog skye ba med// dkar nag ltos pas grub pa'i phyir// dran dang shes bzhin bag yod gsum// dkar po'i phyogs kyi rtsa ba yin// rnam rtog med na rtsa ba zhig /de bas rnam rtog ngo mtshar che/ ༈ paṇ+ḍi ta'i dpyad bsgom gyis lam bzod tshul/ pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa yi// gnyen po dngos por gyur pa yis// spang bya dngos por gyur pa dag

/tho bas bum pa bshig pa bzhin// spang bya spong byed de ltar bzhed// de bas grangs med gsum dag tu// lam la nan tan bskyed gyur kyang*// dus gsum sangs rgyas rgyal sa der// skyes bu dam pa phyin par dka'// khyed rang lugs kyi gzhung lugs la// dngos po med pa dpag med bshad// snga phyi'i tshigs rnams 'gal gyur pa// rig pa'i gnas lnga sbyangs pa yi// paṇ+ḍi ta rnams ji ltar lags// mad kyang ku re bgyis pa lags/ ༈ ku sā li'i 'jog sgom gyi khyad par/ ku sā li ba'i sgom chen rnams// dam pa gcig la brten nas ni// las zin pa yi rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i skyes bu yi// drung du sems thag bcad par bya/ ༈ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu/ sgrub pa rgyun chad med mdzad na// snang ba slob dpon 'char nas yong*/ ༈ mthar thug gi 'bras bu/ snang srid ma lus thams cad kyang*// bde chen nyid du rtogs par mchi/ ༈ don bsdu ba/ 'gags dang nyag zin tsa na// tshig tshogs sprin phung 'khrigs gyur kyang*// skye med ngang du kha ba babs/ ༈ mjug gi don/ zab mo yi ger bris pa la// bla ma ḍā kis bzod par gsol// dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gis// 'gro drug rnam rtog zad par shog /rje btsun zla 'od gzhon nu'i chos kyi khri chen por mtshungs pa med pa'i seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa'i chos kyi rgyal por lha (356)dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis mngon par dbang bskur ba'i bde bar gshegs pa chen po rdo rje rgyal po'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// ༈ // ༄༅// dpal phag mo gru pa'i gsung nā ro chos drug gi bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dang gdams ngag gnad kyi dbye ba mdor bsdus pa bzhugs so/// / ༄༅// na mo rat+na gu ru/ bla ma nā ro pa'i chos drug gi bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dang*// gdams ngag gnad kyi dbye ba mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ ༈ dpal phag mo gru pa'i lugs kyi thabs lam tshigs bcad ma 'di la gsum klad dang*/

gzhung dang mjug go /dang po la gnyis/ mchod par brjod pa dang*/ brtsam par dam bca' ba'o// dang po ni/ mnyam med rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma rje btsun rin po che// dngos grub byin rlabs 'byung ba'i gnas// skal ldan rnams la skyob mdzad dpal// bka' drin can la phyag 'tshal te/ ༈ gnyis pa ni/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dang*// gdams pa gnad kyi dbye ba gnyis// rje btsun gsung bgros la brten nas// mdor bsdus bdag gis bri bar bya/ ༈ gnyis pa gzhung la gsum/ lo rgyus/ gdams pa dngos/ de las 'phros pa'i// dang po ni/ de la bla ma'i brgyud pa ni/ zhing khams bde ldan 'og min gnas// bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang chen la// sdud pa po yis zhu ba mdzad// rdo rje 'chang dang phyag rdor gnyis// tha dad yod pa ma yin te// dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud las kyang*// 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga*// rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa nga*/ zhes so// des ni shar phyogs za hor yul// bla ma tai lo pa la gnang*// de yi lo rgyus mgo smos ni// res 'ga' te lo gcig tu snang*// res 'ga' te lo mang por byon// res 'ga' dge slong cha byad 'dzin// res 'ga' rnal 'byor pa yi gzugs// ras kyi ang rag gsol ba dang*// phyag na nya (357)mo bsnams shing byon// ye shes gnyis la mnga' brnyes pas// rdo rje 'chang dang 'dra bar gsungs// bla ma nyid kyi zhal nas kyang*// mi brjed gzungs thob nā ro pa// bcu gnyis bar du nga bsten byas// sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya yis// ār+ya de ba klu sgrub dang*// bcom ldan 'das dang nga gtam byas// chos nyid bden pa ngas kyang mthong*// nga yi rtogs pa kho la yod// phyi rabs don gnyer rnal 'byor rnams// rtogs par 'dod na kho la thug /zhes so// de la ka chen bzhi yod de// klu sgrub dang ni lū yi pa// kun tu bzang mo lwa ba'o// te lo nā ga rā dza yis// bla ma nā ro pa la gnang*// jo bo chen po nā ro pas// yi ge bdun pa 'bum phrag gcig

/bzlas pas sa g.yos lung bstan thob// shar phyogs ngos su te lo btsal// kra ma shī lar te lo rnyed// lo ni bcu gnyis bar du bsten// dka' ba rnam pa bcu gnyis spyad// ma gus skad cig tsam ma skyes// rgya phub smyig tshal lus zam dang*// thang dang rgyal btsun blon btsun dang*// nam phyed chos ston tshogs 'khor dang*// tshod ma gnye bo me gsum ste// dka' ba rnam pa bcu gnyis so// de mthar maṇ+ḍal bcas pa dang*// gdams ngag gnang ba'i zhu ba phul// te los spyan gnyis cer te mdzad// mchil l+h+wam nā ro'i dpral bar brgyag /bla ma nā ro dar cig brgyal// de nas brgyal ni sang tsam na// sde snod rgyud sde ma lus pa// tshig don bcas pa thugs la gsal// 'phral du gtum mo a thung gsungs// sems nyid chos skur ngo sprod mdzad// mtshan nyid bzhi yi mgur yang gsungs// de ltar rgyud ni byin rlabs nas// slob dpon rnam gnyis so sor bzhud// de nas bla ma nā ro pas// phul+la ha ri'i dgon pa der// lo ni bcu gnyis rtogs pa bskyangs// (358)gzhan don byang phyogs sgo yang srung*// de ltar sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub brnyes// de nas spyod pa mdzad pa'i tshe// res 'ga' seng ge la bcibs nas// nam mkha' la gshegs rdzu 'phrul ston// res 'ga' slong ba'i spyod pa mdzad// mi thogs rdzu 'phrul dpag med kyis// shān+ti pa yi nga rgyal bcag /paṇ+ḍi ta la mngon shes bstan// khwa ta rengs dang lhung ba dang*// glang chen lus la grong 'jug dang*// 'byung bzhi dbang du 'dus pa dang*// tshe gcig 'ja' lus chos sku thob// de yis gdams shing byin rlabs pa// lho brag mar pa lo tsā de// gzhon dus spyod pa thu ba dang*// blo shed gzhan las rgod pa'i rgyus// yab gcig dam chos nyan bcug pas// gtsang dang lho bal gnyis kar byon// rgya gar yul du thang gsum byon// dpal chen nā ro la sogs pa'i// bla ma grub thob mang po bsten// gser gyi zhabs tog mang po mdzad// rgyud dang gdams ngag gnyis ka zhus// rlung sems gnyis la dbang thob pas// byol song lus la grong 'jug dang*// steng gi sgo la gshegs pa dang*// rdzas kyi nus pa thon pa ste// gsang sngags snyan brgyud gter kha phye// des ni gdams shing byin rlabs pa// gzhung gi bla ma rngog ston te// gzhon pa'i dus su rnying ma gsan// de nas mar pa'i rtsa ru byon// rgyud dang gdams pa gnyis ka zhus// bdag med lha mo bco lnga yi// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo thang gsum gzigs// de ltar gnyis kyi gdams pa ni// mang gung mtshams kyi rje btsun de// mi chos shin tu kha dman pa// dbus su mthu tshol mar la byon// mthu bslab yar byon gtsang rong du// ston pa lha dga' bya ba la// dam chos rdzogs pa chen po gsan// de (359)nas mar pa'i spyan sngar byon// rgyud dang gdams pa gnyis ka zhus// zhu gtugs bla ma rngog la byas// de nas gung thang yul du byon// dgun cig grong gi ltag tu bsgom// de nas ri khrod nyi tshe 'grims// lo gsum lon nas gtum mo grub// gung thang gnas su sgom rtags thon// rabs chad rgan rgon gnyis kyi bu// 'bras bre gsum dang mar tshud cig

/sha gzugs gcig dang gsum bskur nas// bla ma la phyi'i gangs la bzhud/ kha ba dgun ni ril bor bab// zla ba gsum du gangs la bzhugs// dpyid ka yul mi tshol du phyin// bla ma ma 'das bzhugs par snang*// tshol mi rnams kyis ngo mtshar skyes// de nas yul du byon pa zhus// bla mas gangs kyi mgur bzhengs so// de nas dpon g.yog tshan gcig dang*// dpal gro kha ru gshegs pa'i tshe// lam du tshong pa mang po byung*// bla ma'i snga la tshong dpon 'jus// bla mas sba ber mgur gsungs so// brin gyi yul du nam mkha' la// seng ge bcibs nas byon pa dang*// bud med gcig gis gsol btab pas// mo yi rwa ze'u nang du ni// nyin re thang gsum byon pa dang*// yon bdag gcig gi snang ba la// mchod rten gcig tu mthong ba dang*// nam mkha'i dbyings la gshegs pa dang*// g.yang la lhung bas nyes med ngang*// lo re gsang nas phul do yi// bshos kyis chog pa'i lo rgyus dang*// kha ba'i lam la 'phur ba dang*// mkha' 'gros gsol rgyu 'drin pa dang*// yon tan dpag med mnga' ba ste// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob// dpe gdams byin gyis brlabs pa ni// gnyal gyi rje btsun lha rje de// dad pa'i ri rgyal brtan pa yis// sku nas nyi shu rtsa drug la// lhag pa tshul khrims bslab pa rdzogs// byang sems blo ldan bya ba la// gdams (360)ngag zhus nas bsgoms pa yis// lo ni sum cu tham pa na// lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa rdzogs// jo bo rje nas brgyud pa yi// gdams ngag ma lus gsan pa dang*// sku nyams bzhes pas thugs la 'khrungs// de nas rje btsun mi la yi// lo rgyus gsan nas dad pa skyes// tshol du gshegs pa'i sbyor ba mdzad// brin gyi kha ru rje dang mjal// rje yis ma 'ongs lung bstan gsungs// zla ba bcu gsum bar du bsten// zhal gdams bka' babs bcas pa gnang*// thabs lam bsgoms pas grub pa brnyes// lhag pa shes rab bslab pa rdzogs// de nas 'ol dwags myang gsum du// sgrub pa'i 'bras bu brtan par mdzad// sgam por 'ja' tshon gdugs su phub// myang rong bar gyi gtsang khyab la// bying ba med par bzhud pa dang*// 'phar tshang chos gos zer la bkal// grong mo phug gi dgon par ru// byon pa med par bzhugs pa dang*// ye shes dag pa'i snang ba la// mngon shes drug dang ldan pa dang*// phyag zhabs 'khor los brgyan pa dang*// skal ldan mang po sgrol ba ste// rgyal ba rnams dang yon tan mnyam// zhabs drung bka' drin kho bos zhus/

gnyis pa gdams pa dngos la/ gnyis mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ de ltar grub thob man ngag 'di// bsdu na rnam pa gsum du 'dus// dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o/ ༈ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum// gzhi dngos po'i gnas lugs/ lam ji ltar bgrod pa/ 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad do// dang po ni/ dngos po'i gnas lugs gnyis yin te// lus dang sems kyi gnas lugs so/ ༈ gnyis pa la gnyis/ lus dngos po'i gnas lugs dang*/ sems dngos po'i gnas lugs so// dang po ni/ (361)de la lus kyi gnas lugs ni// bar do'i shes pas rgyu byas te// pha ma yab yum rkyen byas pas// shes pa ma yin mngal du zhugs// mer mer po dang gor gor po// mkhrang gyur nya yi rnam par chags// pho ni rdo rje lta bur chags// spyi bo bde chen 'khor/lo// ni// 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis chags// mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo ni// 'dab ma bcu drug pa ru chags// snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo ni// 'dab ma brgyad par chags pa yin// lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo ni// 'dab ma drug cu bzhi bar chags// rtsa la dbye na sum su gnyis// bsdus na ro rkyang dbu ma gsum// de yang brtag pa gnyis pa las// rdo rje'i lus la rtsa du lags// rtsa rnams ni sum cu rtsa gnyis te// byang chub kyi sems sum cu rtsa gnyis 'bab pa bde ba chen po'i gnas su 'dzin pa'o// de'i nang nas rtsa rnam pa gsum ni gtso bo ste/ rkyang ma/ ro ma/ kun dhar ma'o// zhes so// yang na 'di ltar shes bya ste// lung gsum mdo dang ri gsum rtse// ri bo'i logs dang steng 'og dang*// bdud rtsi lnga dang rnam rtog dang*// mi gtsang rdzas kyis gang ba'o// rje btsun mi la'i zhal nas kyang*// lus ni byang chub rnam lnga dang*// rtsa dang byang chub sems dang ni// mi gtsang rdzas dang rnam rtog gis// lus kyi chos ni gnas pa yin// zhes so// de ni lus kyi gnas lugs so/

༈ gnyis pa ni/ sems kyi gnas lugs bstan pa ni// sna tshogs shar ba mtshan nyid yin// rang bzhin gsal la brjod du med// ngo bo skye med blo las 'das// rje btsun te lo'i zhal snga nas// kye ho 'di ni rang rig ste// ngag gi spyod yul lam las 'das// te lo nga yis bstan du med// rang gis mtshon te shes par byos// te lo pa yi chos drug la// mi mno mi bas2ma mi sems dang*// (362)mi bsgom4 dang ni mi da5pyod dang*// rang bzhin dag tu gnas6 pa'o// de yang brtag pa gnyis pa las// rang gi rig pa'i ye shes 'di// ngag gi lam 'das spyod yul te// 'di ni byin rlabs rim pa'i phyir// kun mkhyen ye shes de lta bu// zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so// de ni sems kyi gnas lugs so/ ༈ gnyis pa lam la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ lam gyi gnas thabs bstan pa ni// rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste// smin par byed pa dbang dang ni// grol bar byed pa lam nyid do/ ༈ gnyis pa la gnyis/ smin byed dang*/ grol byed do// dang po ni/ smin lam dbang la rnam pa gnyis// gdod nas rang chas yod pa dang*// rkyen gyis dbang bskur tshul gyis so// rkyen gyis bskur la dbang bzhi ste// rang gi le'ur shes par bya/ ༈ gnyis pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas bshad do// dang po ni/ grol lam la yang rnam pa gnyis// bskyed rim dang ni rdzogs rim mo// de'ang brtag pa gnyis pa las// bskyed pa'i rim pa nyid dang ni// rdzogs pa yi yang rim pa nyid// rim gnyis mnyam par gnas nas ni// rdo rje can gyis chos 'chad do// zhes pa'o/ ༈ gnyis pa la gnyis/ bskyed rim dang*/ rdzogs rim mo// dang po ni/ bskyed rim la yang rnam pa gnyis// mang ldan dang ni nyung ldan no// bsgom lugs so so'i gzhung las shes// de yang brtag pa gnyis pa las// ji ltar rim pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i// bskyed dang zhes pa la sogs pa'o/

༈ gnyis pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad do// dang po ni/ rdzogs rim la yang gnyis yin te// rang lus thabs ldan rdzogs rim dang*// gzhan lus shes rab rdzogs rim mo/ ༈ gnyis pa la gnyis/ gzhan lus dang*/ rang lus so// dang po ni/ 'di la rkang grangs bcu (363)bzhi ste// srung dang tshogs gsog rnam gnyis kyis// bsod nams tshogs ni bsags byas la// ye shes tshogs ni chags lam ste// phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid btag pa dang*// dgug dang mi mthong bya ba dang*// 'khor ba'i rgyun bcad lus zung rgyas// sgyu mar blta dang rtsa bslang dang*// rtsa btsal ba dang tha mal gyi// zhen pa bzlog nas lhar bya dang*// byang sems dbab dang gzung ba dang*// bzlog dang rlung dang bsre ba dang*// rtsa mig dag tu gdab pa'o// de ltar rkang grangs bcu bzhi'o// de las lhan cig skyes pa 'byung*// de yang brtag pa gnyis pa las// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i thabs dang ni// zhes so/ ༈ gnyis pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad do// dang po ni/ rang lus thabs ldan rdzogs rim la// bla ma rin chen bzhed la yis// nā ro'i chos bzhir mtshan 'dogs te// bsgoms pas sangs rgyas gtum mo dang*// sgyu lus sangs rgyas rmi lam dang*// gnyid kyis sangs rgyas 'od gsal dang*// ma bsgoms sangs rgyas 'pho ba'o// bar do rgyab brten yin par bzhed/ ༈ gnyis pa la rtsa ba'i chos bzhi ste/ gtum mo// rmi lam/ 'od gsal/ 'pho ba'o// dang po ni/ de la gtum mo'i gdams ngag la// gnad ni rnam pa lnga ru gsungs// lus dang rtsa dang dus dang rlung*// yul gyi gnad dang rnam lnga ste// lag len bla ma'i zhal las shes// lung ni brtag pa gnyis pa las// lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis// de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsregs shing*// spyan la sogs pa yang bsregs te// haṃ bsregs ri bong can rgyun 'bab// ces so/ ༈ gnyis pa ni/ rmi lam la yang rnam pa gsum// lus dang yul dang dus dang gsum// lus ni tsog pur byas pa'am// yang na (364)sngas mtho bcug la nyal// yul ni rmi lam dus dag tu// sems kyi rgyal po mgrin par gnas// de phyir mgrin par sems gtad bya// dus ni gnyid 'thug srab la min// bar ma do la gzung bar bya// de yang rmi lam lugs gnyis te// don lnga ma dang don bzhi'o// rmi lam 'du shes sngon btang dang*// rmi lam gzung dang sbyang ba dang*// sbel dang de nyid bsgom pa'o// don bzhi ma yang 'di lta ste// gnyid kyi 'khrul pa bcad pa'i phyir// rmi lam gzung dang rmi lam sbyang*// rmi lam 'khrul pa bcad pa'i phyir// ya nga byung na sgyu mar bsgom// sgyu ma'i 'khrul pa bcad pa'i phyir// de kho na nyid du bsgom pa'o// de yang bla ma'i zhal las dris// lung ni brtag pa gnyis pa las// dang po sprin dang 'dra ba yin// zhes pa la sogs gsungs pa dang*// grub pa sgyu ma 'di lta ste// rtag tu rmi lam lta bur 'gyur// nyal dang log pa'i khyad par las// dngos grub mtshan ma mi phyed pa'i// phyag rgya rnal 'byor pa yis 'grub// zhes so/

༈ gsum pa ni/ gnyid kyis sangs rgyas 'od gsal la// gnad ni rnam pa gsum yin te// lus kyi gnad dang yul dang dus// lus ni g.yas pa phab la nyal// dus ni gnyid 'thug dus su bzung*// yul ni gnyid 'thug dus tsam na// sems kyi rgyal po snying gar gnas// de phyir snying gar dmigs pa gtad// lag len bla ma'i zhal las shes// lung ni brtag pa gnyis pa las// bsam gtan nyid ni dmigs mi bya// gnyid ni spang bar mi bya ste// dbab bo rnams ni mi dgag go /zhes so/ ༈ bzhi pa ni/ ma bsgoms sangs rgyas 'pho ba la// rnam pa gsum du shes par bya// sbyangs nas 'pho dang btsan thabs 'pho// grong 'jug 'pho dang gsum yin no// sbyangs nas 'pho ba (365)la yang gsum// gang zag dbang po'i bye brag gis// rab kyi 'pho ba 'od gsal yin// 'bring gi 'pho ba sgyu lus dang*// tha ma'i 'pho ba bskyed rim yin// 'od gsal la yang rnam gnyis te// sngon du goms dang 'chi ka'o// sgyu ma la yang rnam gnyis te// mngon dga' dang ni 'chi dus so// bskyed rim 'pho la'ang gsum du 'dod// rlung sbyang pa dang 'pho ba sbyang*// 'pho ba dngos dang gsum yin no// de yang brtag pa gnyis pa las// ji ltar pha las bde thob pa// de yi bde ba rang gis bza'// zhes pa la sogs pa dang ni// gdan bzhi las kyang bshad pa yin/ ༈ zhar byung bar do ni/ bar do la ni bzhi yin te// bar do sbyang dang bar do bsre// bar do bzung dang bar do dngos// bar do dngos la bzhi yin te// dang po 'od gsal ngos gzung bya// de ma zin na sgyu lus bzung*// de yang ma zin mngal sgo dgag /de ma khogs na mngal gdams bya// lag len thams cad zhal las rag /lung ni brtag pa gnyis pa las// ji ltar sgyu ma rmi lam dang*// ci ltar bar ma'i srid yin la// rtag tu goms pa 'byongs pa las// dkyil 'khor gyi ni de bzhin 'dod// zhes so/ de rnams kyis dngos su chos lnga dang*// rmi lam gyi shugs las sgyu lus bstan pas na chos drug ste/

/de tshos lam gyi gnas thabs bstan/ ༈ gsum pa 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa la gnyis/ 'bras bu grub pa'i rgyu dang*// des grub pa'i 'bras bu'o// dang po ni/ 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa ni// dang po me drod lta bu 'byung*// gnyis pa bde ba lta bu 'byung*// gsum pa mi rtog skye bar 'gyur// de nas rnam rtog shugs la 'gags// du ba la sogs rtags rnams mthong*// 'du ba rnam bzhis gnod mi nus// mi rtog ye shes rgyun shar na// mchog gi dngos grub thob pa yin// des na sgrub pa gtsor bya gces// (366)༈ gnyis pa la gnyis/ thun mong gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug mchog gi 'bras bu'o// dang po ni/ bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa la// gnas skabs rtags rnams 'byung ba dang*// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub kyang*// skad cig gcig gis lhun gyis grub// dga' ba bzhi yang shugs kyis 'grub// phyi yi tsha grang bzod pa dang*// skyigs bu 'don par mi nus dang*// lus la srog chags med pa dang*// sha bkrag gting nas 'bar ba dang*// lus la dri ma mi chags dang*// shing bal lta bur yang ba dang*// brkyang bskum gar yang mnyen pa dang*// dbugs kyi 'gro 'ong mi tshor dang*/ kha sna rna lud nyung ba dang*// gnyid kyi rtog pa 'gags pa dang*// zas skom 'du shes chung ba dang*// rna bar sgra brnyan thos pa dang*// dri ba'i lan ldon mkhas pa dang*// smra ba snyan par smra ba dang*// tshig gi sdeb sbyor mkhas pa dang*// pha rol skyon rnams 'chos pa dang*// rang gis yon tan bskyung ba dang*// smra ba'i don dang mthun pa dang*// rdzas la chog shes yod pa dang*// 'khor la skyo ba skye ba dang*// dben pa'i gnas la dga' ba dang*// gcig pur sdod snying 'dod pa dang*// yang yang bsgom snying 'dod pa dang*// lus nyid yod par mi tshor dang*// gnas la nges pa med pa dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams 'du ba dang*// rmi lam lung ston 'byung ba dang*// chos la rang byan tshud pa dang*// mngon shes rim gyis 'byung ba dang*// sa bla sa steng sa 'og gi

/ril bu la sogs 'grub pa dang*// 'pho ba'i nus pa thon pa dang*/ kha ton bye brag shes pa dang*/ rlung yun ring*/ /bsdams kyang gnod pa med pa dang*// bskal par bsdams kyang tshugs pa dang*// dus la bab na gtong ba dang*// dus min lha rnams gsod la sogs// nus pa sna tshogs byung gyur kyang*// de la yid ches mi bya'o// de la yid ches skyes pa (367)na// rnam rtog bdud kyi dbang du 'gro// de de yin te de nyid min// sdong bu yin te 'bras bu min// yon tan yin te rtog med min/ ༈ gnyis pa ni/ yang dag don gyi rtogs tshod ni// dper na lkugs pa'i rmi lam mam// gzhon nu ma yi dga' ba bzhin// mtshon pa tsam las mngon sum par// de ni brjod par nus ma yin/ ༈ gsum pa de las 'phros pa'i don la gnyis/ gegs sel dang*/ gdams pa'i snod brtag pa'o// dang po ni/ las dang skal bar 'dzoms pa la// bdud bzhi'i dgra yis tshugs par dka'// bcos thabs dpag tu med mod kyi// dag snang mos gus gtsigs su che/ ༈ gnyis pa ni/ kha bsag g.yo sgyu can rnams dang*// mang shes 'di la skyems pa dang*// rdzas la ltos nas ston rnams la// sbyin par mi bya sems dkyil sba// dka' spyad bzod par nus pa dang*// sdug bsngal che la mi lta zhing*// rgyud brtan gnyugs sring bsgom nus la// tshod dang sbyar zhing gnang bar bya/ ༈ gsum pa sbyar byang gis mjug bsdu ba ni/ rje btsun nā ro pa'i gdams pa// bla ma rnams kyi nyams myong gsungs tshad dang*// rang nyid kyi nyams myong skye lugs dang bcas pa'o// nā ro pa'i chos drug gi bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dang*/ gdams ngag gnad kyi dbye ba mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal phag mo gru pas mdzad pa/ ban+de bkra shis dpal gyis yi ger bris pa/ skal ldan slob ma la phan thogs par gyur cig /shubha mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/// /(368)
